issues.label: Problem1
issues.status: Demonstrated false boundary identity with exact local correction

source_location.claim: Proposition5.10, equation(5.12), Remark5.2; use in Theorem7.6

issues.hypotheses: Q=(-3,3)^3, QI=(-1,1)^3; smooth b supported(3/2,5/2), equal1 near2, values[0,1]; sigma2=b(x2), sigma1=sigma3=0. Qdelta retains a flat patch near(3,2,0). tau=T>0 arbitrarily large. Constant E=e2,B=e3 are H2. Proposition5.10 assumes arbitrary H2 fields and imposes no PDE or boundary condition on this test.
issues.suspect_step: Both projected boundary terms are stated as s*pi^±(tau W+C), although D has unweighted tau*Ptan W and its cross part is A(m)C.
issues.decisive_evidence: At the flat point m=(1+1/T)e1, s=1+1/T, W=(e2,e3) lies in E+(m). Derivatives vanish, so pi+D=TW while the claimed right side is(T+1)W. The discrepancy remains nonzero for all large T. Exact algebra yields pi^±D=tau*pi^±W±s*pi^±C.
method: Complete analytic calculation with all stated hypotheses
Actual source formula and dependency-page inspection
counterevidence_and_alternatives: Normalizing m only inside the projector leaves the projector unchanged and cannot fix the unnormalized cross terms.
For a homogeneous local Maxwell field, C=-tau W and zero divergences, pi-W=0 gives D=tau(1-s)pi+W; local W=exp(-T*x1)(e2,e3) realizes nonzero D on the flat patch.
The local Maxwell example is not asserted to satisfy all global face conditions.
The unstretched positive-projection special case s=1 does not show the scaling error.
No PML instability or false principal weighted-L2 theorem is inferred.

repair.statement: Replace tau*Ptan W in D by tau*s*Ptan W to define Ds. Then pi^±Ds=s*pi^±(tau W±C).
repair.proof: Cross part A(m)C has eigenvalues±s under pi^± and the normal term is killed. With homogeneous Maxwell equations, zero divergences and pi-W=0, all spectral components of Ds vanish.
repair.verified_scope: Exact projected algebra and local Maxwell boundary cancellation only; no complete modified Helmholtz/variational estimate proof.

issues.dependency: Proposition5.10 -> Remark5.2 -> Section7 opening and explicit cancellation in Theorem7.6 on p55 -> Theorem8.1 -> Theorems1.15/1.16.
issues.severity_basis: A displayed identity used to remove a boundary integral on the central proof path is false. The bounded local correction does not establish the full downstream argument.

issues.label: Problem2
issues.status: Demonstrated false complex stretched Rellich identity
issues.hypotheses: Same admissible smooth absorption as Problem1; interior point(0,2,0), E=e2 constant real and C1; tau=T+i with T>0 arbitrarily large. Stretched coordinate derivatives satisfy dtilde_j X_j=1 and d_2X_2=d=1+1/tau, a=tau/(tau+1).
issues.suspect_step: A formula containing Re of a tau-dependent stretched coordinate is continued to complex tau on the assertion that every term is holomorphic.
issues.decisive_evidence: For the printed(6.6), L=3/2-a*Re(d) and R=1/2. L-R=-i*a/(T^2+1) is nonzero for every T>0. At T=2, L=13/25-7i/50 and L-R=(1-7i)/50.
method: Exact symbolic residual for general positive T and exact T=2 evaluation
counterevidence_and_alternatives: E is real, so conjugation of the field cannot explain the discrepancy.
Adding an outer Re to the left still gives real residual1/50 at T=2.
Real tau and zero absorption special cases can satisfy the identity; the failure concerns complex continuation with the stated nonzero absorption.
Outer absolute values in Proposition6.3 are actually present; no finding is based on the text extraction losing them.
The counterexample is to the identity, not to the trace inequalities.

repair.statement: No complete repaired complex trace estimate is claimed.
repair.proof: The counterexample identifies conjugate-dependent terms that an actual complex-parameter derivation must retain and estimate.
repair.verified_scope: Identity failure and dependency only; final inequalities remain unrefuted.

issues.dependency: Lemma6.4 -> multiplying and integrating(6.6) to(6.9) -> Proposition6.3 -> Proposition6.1 ->(7.9)/Proposition7.3 -> Theorem7.6.
issues.severity_basis: The invalid continuation is used to obtain a central boundary estimate needed to close the main a priori estimate.

issues.label: Problem3
issues.status: Counterexample to Theorem8.1 H2 regularity under stated L2 input hypotheses

source_location.claim: Theorem8.1 H2-valued holomorphic solution for compact L2 current/charge

issues.hypotheses: All absorptions zero; eta smooth compactly supported in QI and equal1 near0; psi=eta|x1|; J=curl(0,0,psi), R=0, with J constant as an L2-valued function of tau. Compact support and -divJ=tau R hold distributionally; J,R are entire in tau.
issues.suspect_step: An L2-to-H2 Helmholtz inverse is applied to(-tau J-gradR,curlJ), whose differentiated sources need only lie in H^-1 under the stated assumptions.
issues.decisive_evidence: Near0, J=(0,-sgn(x1),0), so d1J2=-2*delta_{x1=0} locally, not L2; hence J is not H1. If F,G were H2 and tau F-curlG=-J, then J=-tau F+curlG would be H1, a contradiction for every positive real tau.
method: Complete analytic function-space contradiction with admissible compact divergence-free current
Actual theorem and earlier regularity observation inspection
counterevidence_and_alternatives: The boundary condition cannot resolve an interior Sobolev contradiction.
The source itself notes the extra H1 current regularity forced by an H2 field on p25.
The weaker L2 solution conclusion of Theorem1.15 is not contradicted.
A density argument from smooth compatible sources may repair a weaker existence statement, but all its trace and parameter properties must be proved.

repair.statement: No complete repaired theorem or density passage is claimed.
repair.proof: The report states the necessary regularity obstruction and a possible smooth-source/weak-limit route without certifying that route.
repair.verified_scope: False intermediate H2 assertion only, not failure of main L2 well-posedness.

issues.dependency: Theorem8.1 supplies smooth-domain existence; its H2 property permits Proposition3.4 converse before the delta limit used for Theorem1.15.
issues.severity_basis: A central intermediate existence/regularity theorem is false on its stated domain, and the displayed construction has the same source-space mismatch.

issues.label: Problem4
issues.status: Demonstrated missing source term in split existence reconstruction, with complete transformed algebraic correction

source_location.claim: Equation(8.12) compared with(8.11),(8.15); proof of Theorem1.16

issues.hypotheses: sigma_k=0, nonconstant real phi smooth compactly supported in QI, allowed weights c1=1,c2=c3=0. For t>=0 j=e^-t gradphi, rho=-(1-e^-t)Deltaphi, both zero for t<0. Compatibility holds with no delta at t0, spatial supports are compact in QI and both sources are in e^(mu t)L2 for every mu>0.
issues.suspect_step: Printed Uhat_k=-(tau+sigma_k)^-1 A_k d_k W omits fhat_k, but the ensuing equations assert the forced split system and sum Uhat_k=W.
issues.decisive_evidence: J=gradphi/(tau+1), R=-Deltaphi/[tau(tau+1)] and W=(-gradphi/[tau(tau+1)],0) solve the stretched equations and vanish near every boundary face. A(d)W=0, so the printed component sum is0 while W is nonzero.
method: Actual printed construction and preceding forced equation inspection
counterevidence_and_alternatives: Preceding(8.11) already contains the forcing and supports the correction as an omission.
Interchanging electric/magnetic block order cannot create the missing term.
The example uses smooth data, so the failure is distinct from Problem3.
This does not refute existence after the displayed correction.

repair.proof: The stretched equation gives W=fhat/tau-sum_k(tau+sigma_k)^-1 A_k d_k W. Since sigma_k=0 on supp fhat_k and sum fhat_k=fhat, summing the corrected formula gives W exactly, and each transformed split equation follows.
repair.verified_scope: Complete transformed reconstruction algebra conditional on a suitable stretched solution; not all preceding estimate/existence steps or every time-domain regularity claim.

issues.dependency: Equation(8.12) -> asserted source reconstruction and output sum -> existence proof of Theorem1.16.
issues.severity_basis: The printed construction on the direct central existence path does not produce the prescribed source/output. A short algebraic repair is available but does not erase the failure or repair the other issues.

issues.label: Problem5
issues.status: Counterexample to overbroad smooth-spatial-coefficient holomorphic stretching lemma

source_location.claim: Lemma1.11 and the explicit constant-spatial-coefficient use restriction immediately following

issues.hypotheses: Same nonzero smooth absorption; S=int_0^2 b>0. h(z)=0 for z<=0 and exp(-1/z^2) for z>0, smooth on R. Operator P is multiplication by a(X)=h(X2-(2+S)), independent of tau and therefore holomorphic in tau.
issues.suspect_step: Spatial smoothness is treated as sufficient to extend the coefficient composition with complex stretched coordinates holomorphically.
issues.decisive_evidence: At x=(0,2,0), real positive stretching gives a(X(tau,x))=h(S(tau^-1-1)); it vanishes for all tau>=1 and is positive for0<tau<1. A holomorphic extension on the connected right half-plane is impossible by the identity theorem.
method: Actual coefficient hypotheses and restriction inspection
counterevidence_and_alternatives: The paper explicitly limits its uses of this correspondence to constant spatial coefficients.
The constant-spatial-coefficient differential substitution has holomorphic rational stretch coefficients and is valid.
This local overstatement is distinct from the real-part continuation defect of Problem2.

repair.statement: Restrict to spatially constant coefficients for the applications actually used.
repair.proof: Substitution of d_Xj by tau/(tau+sigma_j(x_j))*d_j gives finite sums/products of holomorphic coefficients and their spatial derivatives on Re tau>0.
repair.verified_scope: Constant-spatial-coefficient construction only; no general smooth coefficient extension.

issues.dependency: General lemma statement; source explicitly limits subsequent uses to a valid constant-coefficient setting.
issues.severity_basis: The demonstrated overstatement has no established independent central dependency once the source's stated restricted use is respected.

unresolved_scope: No full replacement complex trace estimate.
No counterexample to the principal weighted-L2 well-posedness statements.
